Plain Client: HTTPS_PROXY without scheme becomes http://corp-proxy:3128 for https:// only; no HTTP_PROXY so http:// direct. NO_PROXY: localhost -> all://localhost; .svc.cluster.local -> all://*.svc.cluster.local (subdomains only, not bare); 10.0.0.0/8 -> all://10.0.0.0/8 but URLPattern doesn't do CIDR so never matches. Results: api.svc.cluster.local direct; svc.cluster.local proxy; 10.2.3.4 proxy; http://localhost direct; http://example.com direct; https://example.com proxy. (a) proxy= ignores env incl NO_PROXY: all via proxy incl http. (b) mounts={"https://": transport}: env proxies still read, user mount replaces https:// env mount; api.svc direct, others https direct via custom transport, proxy no longer used for https; http direct. Docs: environment_variables.md says URL required; NO_PROXY examples misleading for CIDR/bare domain; proxies.md doesn't say proxy= disables env; mounts override undocumented.

docs/compatibility.md is out of date: charset_normalizer fallback removed in 0.23.0 (CHANGELOG #2165), not a dependency. r.encoding: explicit value, else Content-Type charset, else client default_encoding 'utf-8'; so 'utf-8' and cp1252 bytes become U+FFFD. requests used ISO-8859-1 for text/*. Fix: httpx.Client(default_encoding='cp1252'); applies only when no charset; covers streaming. Callable autodetect only runs if body already read, not for streams. Per-response r.encoding must be set before .text, else ValueError.

httpx/_content.py encode_request raises TypeError for non-mapping data= with message pointing to content=; removed unused warnings import (ruff F401). tests/test_content.py: test_bytes_content and test_iterator_content now check TypeError; removed pytestmark DeprecationWarning filter. docs/compatibility.md Request Content now says TypeError. CHANGELOG Changed entry.

Lock in commandLock.ts, wired by cli.ts, documented in docs/guide/cli.md Process locks. Refused only when another live process has same command, root, config file and mode; port not compared. vite + vite build --watch: both start. Second vite --port 3001: refused. Second vite --mode staging: starts. createServer() from e2e: starts; only the CLI adds the lock (commandLockPlugin / createCommandLock), JS API neither checks nor writes. State: <cacheDir>/lock/<hash>.json (node_modules/.vite/lock/), JSON with command, root, configFile, mode, pid, startTime, urls; removed on close/exit/SIGINT (build also SIGTERM). Stale: dead PID file deleted; live PID compared by startTime (/proc, PowerShell, ps); unknown start time treated as running; --bypass-lock or delete file.
